scope: The Mosque of the Three Doors in the Kairouan medina with its masonry prayer hall, carved western façade and northwest minaret, as documented by the public-domain photograph uploaded in May 2007.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Archnet records the skewed hall dimensions, western portals, minaret geometry, four carved frieze registers and roof and cornice construction.
UNESCO identifies the mosque and its carved façade within the Kairouan medina.
The monument record describes the three portals and twenty-four upper corbels.

sectionBasis: Skewed masonry prayer hall behind three horseshoe portals, four carved frieze bands, corbels and a northwest minaret with coupled arched openings.
